name: YouTube Music
short_desc: Plays YouTube Music in Music. Needs a home internet connection.
description: A music source for Wizard's Music app. YouTube blocks cloud servers, so it works on a Wizard at home, or on a cloud Wizard with a home relay (Wizard Home Relay on a computer at home). The setup screen tests real playback.
author: Humanity Labs

form_fields.label: Trusted Wizard browser origin (scheme and port)
